complete_examples.text: In this paper, a new network architecture of the hybrid CNN and LSTM (CNN-LSTM) model is developed by integrating the advantages of CNN and LSTM to predict the wheel-rail forces of the vehicle-track system subjected to random track irregularity.

According to the principle of the step-by-step integral solution method with respect of the vehicle-track system, the wheel-rail force at t + 1 time is not only closely related to the train response at the previous nτ time, but also to the wheel-rail force of its adjacent times.
